bio.text: Nirav Sheth, a Republican, advanced from the August 4, 2026 primary for Washington's 7th Congressional District and will face Democratic incumbent Pramila Jayapal in the November general election.
PTI described Sheth, 40, as a former police officer turned businessman who was born and raised in Ahmedabad, India.

According to his campaign website as cited by PTI, he came to the United States in 2008 as a student of computer and electrical engineering and joined the U.S. Marines as an aircraft mechanic in 2011.

sources.title: Easy win for Indian-American Jayapal in Washington; sets up fight with Nirav Sheth for November elections – ThePrint – PTIFeed
